title: Generate Aligned Anomaly: Region-Guided Few-Shot Anomaly Image-Mask Pair Synthesis for Industrial Inspection (GAA)
mechanism: Few-shot latent-diffusion anomaly generation with localized concept decomposition, multi-round anomaly clustering, region-guided mask generation and low-quality sample filtering.
adaptation: Per-class few-shot generation for splice (never predicted), corrosion and material on train cells; clustering step can give one concept per source style; benchmark baseline next to AnomalyDiffusion and SeaS (D06).
min_experiment: Benchmark baseline: PF + GAA samples for splice/corrosion/material vs PF. Metric splice IoU (now 0.000) and mIoU_rob. Reported; drop if splice stays 0.
evidence: R: MVTec AD and LOCO; better synthesis quality and downstream localisation and classification than prior generators.

alt_notes.adaptation: Per-class few-shot generation for splice, corrosion, material; one concept per source style.
alt_notes.min_experiment: PF + GAA pairs for rare classes vs PF. Metric splice IoU (now 0.000), material IoU; benchmark baseline. About 20 GPU-h.
